name: Money Momentum Budget System
promise: Track reality, adjust calmly, and keep money momentum visible.
description: A guided money operating system for spending awareness, budget resets, weekly check-ins, and calm recovery.

paths.name: Monthly Money Reset
paths.description: Set the month, catch category drift, and make one clean correction.

sessionTemplates.title: Reset the next money move
sessionTemplates.lead: Capture one real number, then choose one adjustment that keeps the month usable.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Track one real expense and make one small adjustment.
sessionTemplates.companionFrame: The number is information. The adjustment is the system doing its job.

actions.label: Amount reviewed
actions.helper: Use one real transaction, category total, or bill.

actions.label: One adjustment
actions.placeholder: Pause delivery, move $20, reduce one category...

actions.label: Money note
actions.placeholder: What did this number make clearer?

paths.name: Weekly Check In
paths.description: Review the week without rebuilding the entire budget.

sessionTemplates.title: Review the week cleanly
sessionTemplates.lead: Look at the week as a signal, not a verdict.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Choose one category and decide what needs to change next week.

paths.name: No Spend Check
paths.description: Use a short reset when spending needs a calmer boundary.

sessionTemplates.title: Hold the line gently
sessionTemplates.lead: Make the boundary visible and pick the replacement action before impulse shows up.
sessionTemplates.recommendedAction: Name the spending trigger and choose the replacement move.

actions.label: Replacement move
actions.placeholder: Make coffee at home, wait 24 hours, walk instead...

rhythmOptions.label: Daily
rhythmOptions.description: A small daily session that keeps money visible.

rhythmOptions.label: Weekly
rhythmOptions.description: A weekly session for a deeper review without daily pressure.

rhythmOptions.label: Sprint
rhythmOptions.description: A focused push for a short money goal or reset.

rhythmOptions.label: Custom
rhythmOptions.description: Use Draftpace when your schedule actually allows it.

intensityOptions.label: Gentle
intensityOptions.description: One minimum action. Best when you are rebuilding trust.
intensityOptions.companionModifier: Keep the action small enough to repeat.
intensityOptions.recoveryLine: Minimum progress still keeps the system alive.

intensityOptions.label: Steady
intensityOptions.description: A complete but calm session for normal weeks.
intensityOptions.recoveryLine: Return with one clean action and one note.

intensityOptions.label: Intense
intensityOptions.description: A stronger session when you have capacity.
intensityOptions.companionModifier: Use the extra capacity without turning it into pressure.
intensityOptions.recoveryLine: Compress back to the core action if the week shifts.

customizationOptions.label: Budget focus
customizationOptions.description: The money area this System should keep surfacing.

recoveryBehavior.title: Minimum budget reset
recoveryBehavior.trigger: Skipped session, low momentum, or budget drift.
recoveryBehavior.minimumAction: Track one transaction. Ignore the rest for now.
recoveryBehavior.companionLine: Awareness brings you back. The number is information, not a verdict.

storeCard.summary: A guided budgeting system for seeing real numbers without turning the month into a spreadsheet.

dashboardCard.summary: Budget resets, weekly reviews, and recovery behavior are being prepared.
